beats.event: Age 13, aspiring writer at the family's country estate
Intercepts Robbie's crude love letter meant for Cecilia
Witnesses her cousin Lola being assaulted in the dark
Wrongly identifies Robbie as Lola's attacker
Robbie arrested; only Cecilia and his mother believe him
Part Two: Robbie jailed then sent to war in France
Part Three: now a trainee nurse, remorseful
Realizes Paul Marshall was the real attacker
Attends Paul and Lola's wedding; stays silent
Visits Cecilia, finds Robbie there, and apologizes
Postscript: elderly Briony reveals Robbie died at Dunkirk
Reveals Cecilia was killed in the Blitz
Their reunion existed only in her novel
Her final novel becomes her lifelong act of atonement
